title: CRUD - Lifecycle Operations
description: Create, read, write, update, and delete containers and resources.

sections.name: Create
sections.description: Create containers or resource files in work_module.

sections.name: Lift (Copy for Editing)
sections.description: Copies inherited resource from overlay to work_module. Returns file contents.

sections.name: Read
sections.description: Read resource from work_module. Supports wildcards.

sections.name: Write
sections.description: Write to existing resource in work_module. File must exist (use create first). Use --base64 for content with special characters (!, quotes, etc.) to bypass shell escaping.

sections.name: Update (Fix Drift)
sections.description: Auto-syncs inherited fields while preserving extension fields.

sections.name: Delete
sections.description: Remove containers or resources from work_module.
